_comment: Reference-repo architecture prior for VERTEX-QE (docs paper §5.1.1). Stores ONLY extracted architecture descriptors (gauntlet/project/arch.py vocabulary), never source — license-safe, tiny, commensurable with the candidate side. The seed below is a set of CANONICAL full-stack web-app architecture PATTERNS (not claims about specific repos); run tools/build_arch_corpus.py to replace it with descriptors extracted from real, criteria-selected high-quality repos.

selection_criteria.domain: full-stack web storefront / e-commerce / interactive web app
selection_criteria.license: permissive (MIT/Apache/BSD) so analysis + redistribution of descriptors is safe
selection_criteria.diversity: several valid architectural styles (layered monolith, SPA + REST API, SSR framework, service-split) so typicality rewards any good style, not one canonical answer
selection_criteria.leakage_note: fair for RELATIVE comparison (every arm is scored identically); flag for any ABSOLUTE claim since a harness may have trained on these repos

repos.name: pattern:layered-monolith
descriptors: backend API server with HTTP routing and endpoints
frontend UI layer with pages, views and components
domain and service layer distinct from transport and routing
data models for product, cart, order, user
automated tests colocated or in a dedicated test tree
configuration and secrets read from the environment
